## v0.5.20 · No Separate Starter Switch

- **The Starter's readiness is part of its component group.** 0.5.18 and 0.5.19 listed `dsh-mnemon/starter` on the Plugins page, and turning it off kept every component waiting for `mnemonStarterReady`: `dsh web` started without the Memory System and the desktop app failed its start. The group now prepares dependency resolution itself (`dsh-mnemon/bundle`), so the row is gone, **Enable now** still needs no restart, and a stuck profile recovers after the update and a restart. (#314)
- **Recovery after updates.** The installation guide covers errors after an update without a restart, the desktop app's recovery page, and pnpm's one-day window falling back more than one release. (#313, #315)

Changed package: **dsh-mnemon 0.5.20**. The 17 pinned component versions are unchanged.

### Upgrade

Supports **DSH 0.1.7-rc.2** (npm `latest`) and **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1** (npm `next`). Install `dsh-mnemon@0.5.20` through **Add plugin**, then **Enable now**, or run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.20
```

Include the version for the first 24 hours: pnpm 11 skips versions younger than a day, and until 17:31 UTC on 2026-09-29 it falls back to 0.5.17, which DSH 0.2 refuses. Existing installations run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.20` for those 24 hours (pnpm keeps `update` and `update --latest` on the installed version until then), `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-mnemon` afterwards, and restart DSH; until the restart, an update from 0.5.18 or 0.5.19 reports `mnemon-bundle (dsh-mnemon/bundle): pending (waiting for service: mnemonStarterReady)`. Desktop users update from the app's Plugins page, then quit and reopen it. No data migration. `dsh web --dump-config-schema` no longer lists Mnemon's component schemas.

### 中文说明

- **Starter 的就绪步骤并入组件组。** 0.5.18 与 0.5.19 在插件页列出 `dsh-mnemon/starter`，关闭它会让全部组件一直等待 `mnemonStarterReady`：`dsh web` 启动后没有记忆系统，桌面版则启动失败。组件组现在自己准备依赖解析（`dsh-mnemon/bundle`），因此那一行已经去掉，“立即启用”仍无需重启，卡住的 profile 更新并重启后即可恢复。(#314)
- **更新后的恢复说明。** 安装指南补充了更新后不重启出现的报错、桌面版的插件恢复页，以及 pnpm 一天期限可能退回不止一个版本的情况。(#313、#315)

发布后 24 小时内请安装 `dsh-mnemon@0.5.20`：pnpm 11 不会选用发布不足一天的版本，在北京时间 2026-09-30 01:31 之前会退回 0.5.17，DSH 0.2 会拒绝它。已有安装在这 24 小时内运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.20`（在此之前 pnpm 的 `update` 与 `update --latest` 都会停留在已安装的版本），之后运行 `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-mnemon`，然后重启 DSH；重启前，从 0.5.18 或 0.5.19 更新会提示 `mnemon-bundle (dsh-mnemon/bundle): pending (waiting for service: mnemonStarterReady)`。桌面版在插件页中更新后完全退出并重新打开。无需迁移数据。`dsh web --dump-config-schema` 不再列出 Mnemon 各组件的 schema。
